subject: Timelagged Independent Component plots with Amber?

messages.author: Suchetana Gupta
messages.body:
Dear Amber Users
Is there any way within Amber to get tIC (time lagged independent
component) plots from our enhanced sampling trajectories? Or any external
thing where Amber trajectory could be an input for doing these?
Thanks
Suchetana

messages.author: Suchetana Gupta
messages.body:
Hello community
Any help/insights for this?
Thanks
Suchetana

messages.author: Valentin Hörschinger
messages.body:
Hi,
the excellent PyEMMA Python library (
http://www.emma-project.org
)
supports AMBER trajectories directly as it uses mdtraj internally.
There are tutorials available in their documentation of how to produce
free energy plots based on tICs.
Best regards,
Valentin

messages.body:
Thank you everyone. I managed to do the TICA plots using Pyemma on Google
Colab.
However, I had made the dihedral calculations separately using cpptraj
multihedral command and used that data to make my calculations.
Suchetana
